user_goal.text: For each person in owe_list.csv, privately send the specified amount and description by Venmo if they have an account; otherwise create an individual, non-grouped Splitwise expense with the same details and attach the corresponding PDF receipt.

benchmark_success.rationale: The frozen TestTracker succeeds exactly when all 19 registered tests pass.

checked_by.text: The frozen TestTracker executes the case evaluator and reports success exactly when pass_count equals num_tests across the 19 registered requirements.

decisive_artifacts.question: Does the result report success=true with all 19 registered requirements in passes and none in failures?
Does the evaluator-decoded answer equal the official null answer value?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained pre-run and post-run model snapshots or equivalent changed-record diff
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the Venmo, Splitwise, notification, attachment, user, and file-system changes satisfy every registered model-state requirement?
